Officer's narrative
On the reported date I responded to a sideswipe collision in Sugar Land, Texas, involving two vehicles. Driver 1
stated that while changing lanes, the left side of their vehicle made light contact with the right rear of Driver 2's
vehicle. Both drivers remained at the scene. No independent witnesses were located. The Passenger, listed in the
claim as riding in Driver 1's vehicle, reported a severe back strain. The contact appeared minor, and I observed little
to suggest a forceful impact. Scene photographs show damage largely consistent with the described contact, tohugh
a few older scratches on the bumper may predate this event. Driver 2 stated that the Passenger was not inside Driver
1's vehicle when the collision occurred, and my own observations at the scene were cnosistent with that account.
Driver 1 is named on the policy for the vehicle involved. The photographs and statements have been forwarded for
review.
